It's{{sic}} existence alone is a threat to us all.|audio = RiftWalkerQuote.ogg|'''Rift Walker''' in the second [[Outpost 16]] cutscene.}} }} ==Description== The '''Rift Walker''' was a being that had existed since the [[Old World]], being affiliated with [[Two X]]. Despite being addressed as an extremely powerful individual,{{InlineQuote|The '''Rift Walker''' is an being who helped create the [[Meta]] with his master. Together, they maintain the balance of the realms, and will destroy any who threaten it. The Rift Walker is powerful enough to rival greatest enemies from the [[Old World]], and his judgment is absolute. He is known to be strict, for if he fails, everyone from all realities will end up in the [[Old World|Nil Zone]].|[[Rift Walker]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} it is unknown whether the '''Rift Walker''' fought as a warrior on [[Two X]]'s side during the war against [[Lord Exo]]. After the war, the [[Rift Walker]] would help create the different realms in the [[Meta]] with [[Two X]], being put in charge of the monumental duty to watch over and maintain their security, lest it is all undone and reality falls into the [[Old World|Nil Zone]]. If a being or group of beings were to pose a threat to the security of the [[Meta]], it would be up to the '''Rift Walker''' to take care of them, his method of choice usually being banishment to the [[Banlands|Outer Nil Zone]]. ==Personality== The [[Rift Walker]], from what can be gathered from character testimonies and in-game content, is an extremely serious individual, fanatically dedicated to preserving the balance of the [[Meta]], to the point where he had banished T.D.S. agents, the protagonists of the game, to the [[Banlands|Outer Nil Zone]]. This is not to say that the '''Rift Walker''' is blinded by his duties, or harbors secret malice. The '''Rift Walker's''' fears and duties are justified, given how dangerous of a threat [[Lord Exo]] posed not only in the [[Old World]], but even within the [[God Cube]]. To banish someone involved in the merging of [[God Cube]] fragments, regardless if they did not have the intention of freeing [[Lord Exo]], would have been something that he could not afford to think twice about. He has been described by the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] to be "''a total bore''" because he is vehemently against chaos.{{InlineQuote|The great and powerful Rift Walker! A being who transcends time and is obsessed with keeping the [[Meta]] "balanced"-or whatever. Don't do this, don't do that, don't end an entire lineage 'just because'. Where's the chaos? Where's the drama? The guy's a total bore!|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 7 ([[Banlands]])}} ==Abilities & Characteristics== {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" ! colspan="2" |Abilities |- |'''Portal Manipulation''': The '''Rift Walker''' has been shown to create portals for both transportative and offensive purposes. Portals opened by the '''Rift Walker''' can be interdimensional or intradimensional, creating a gateway between realms or two locations within the same realm. |[[File:RiftWalkerConsultsTwoX.gif|center|thumb|200px|The '''Rift Walker''' consulting [[Two X]].]] |- | colspan="2" |'''Temporal Manipulation''': The '''Rift Walker''' is capable of altering time and rewriting history, with the most notable use of this ability being altering history to remove [[Lunar Overture Event]]'s third act from reality.[[File:Act3RewriteProof.png|280x280px]]
https://x.com/BelowNatural/status/2022808259971666007 This has been stated to only be an ability he is capable of using in his and [[Two X]]'s realms, likely the realms that are part of the [[Meta]], but are unable to use it in other realms like the [[Old World|Nil Zone]].{{InlineQuote|The [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] and his master can erase history in their own realms, but not here.|[[Kronus (Narrator)|Kronus]] on Wave 21 ([[Blind Faith]])}} Altering time and history also has the side effect of erasing the memories of those who were there to experience it.{{InlineQuote|We will eradicate your existence SO THOROUGHLY that not even the memory of you will remain.|[[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] in the ending [[Outpost 16]]'s ending cutscene}} |- |'''Merging of God Cube Fragments''': The '''Rift Walker''' can effortlessly merge [[God Cube]] fragments together without the need for technology. |[[File:RiftWalkerControlsHalfGodCube.gif|center|thumb|200px|The '''Rift Walker''' holding the merged half of the [[God Cube]].]] |- ! colspan="2" |Other |- |'''Connection to The Meta''': Since the '''Rift Walker''' is one of the primary forces sustaining the balance of the [[Meta]], if he were to die, all of the realms would collapse, and existence would fall into the [[Old World|Nil Zone]]. |[[File:RiftWalkerDies.gif|center|thumb|200px|"''The realms will collapse, if I die.''"]] |- |'''The Rift Walker's Staff''': The staff that the '''Rift Walker''' wields helps him to walk, but more importantly, it has been shown as the device he uses to facilitate his portal creation. |[[File:RiftWalkerPointStaff.gif|center|thumb|200px]] |} ==Story== ===Old World=== The '''Rift Walker''' is created or born in the [[Old World]]. He pledges his allegiance to [[Two X]], and plays an unknown role in the battle against [[Lord Exo]]. At a certain point, presumably after the battle, he appoints the [[Null Guardian (Story)|Null Guardian]] to patrol the [[Banlands|Outer Nil Zone]].{{InlineQuote|The [[Null Guardian (Story)|Null Guardian]] has existed within the [[Old World|Nil Zone]] since before the [[Old World]], appointed to this role by the '''Rift Walker''' himself. He patrols endlessly, destroying any who enter the "Place Between Realms".|[[Null Guardian (Story)|Null Guardian]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} ===Lunar Overture=== The '''Rift Walker''' intervenes during the third act of the [[Lunar Overture Event]] by rewriting history, removing it from the timeline.[[File:Act3RewriteProof.png|280x280px]]
https://x.com/BelowNatural/status/2022808259971666007 In doing so, he ends up sending some of the actors into other places, like different areas of the Solar Theatres{{InlineQuote|Eventually, their daydream snapped to reality—sitting on a Ferris Wheel, overlooking the wooden bridges.|[[Actor3 (Nil Zone)|Actor3]] description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} or banished them to the [[Old World|Nil Zone]].The [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] is seen there during [[Null & Void Event]] and some of the actor enemies [[Logbooks]] refer to them being repositioned to parts of it.
{{InlineQuote|When the world went blank, the mechanical rot was cast into the [[Old World|Nil Zone]].|[[Mechanical Rot (Nil Zone)|Mechanical Rot]] description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} Anyone who was part of the show experienced the rewrite as a glitch{{InlineQuote|Then, a "glitch" offered an unexpected opportunity. Time had slowed to a crawl and, in an instant, reversed to a moment before the supposed grand finale. They believed the show was finished, but moments later, their memories began to fade away.|[[Actor1 (Nil Zone)|Actor1]] description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} that rewound time. They would initially have the memories of the event, but with time most of the participants eventually had them fade away.{{InlineQuote|They believed the show was finished, but moments later, their memories began to fade away.|[[Actor1 (Nil Zone)|Actor1]] description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} ===Null & Void=== Being ordered by [[Two X]] to protect the [[Meta]], the '''Rift Walker''' travels to [[Outpost 16]], where he merges and takes the [[God Cube]] pieces into his possession, banishing a number of T.D.S. agents to the [[Banlands|Outer Nil Zone]] in the process. After gathering one half of the [[God Cube]], the [[Rift Walker]] then travels to the [[Blind Faith|Nil Zone]] to take the other half, which is held in the [[Children of Exo]]'s possession. Battle ensues, and as the '''Rift Walker''' is about to defeat the [[Children of Exo]], the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]]'s puppet hand is able to restrain him, allowing the [[Children of Exo]] to merge the [[God Cube]] back together. The '''Rift Walker's''' body is used as a vessel to transplant the soul of [[Lord Exo]] into, but after [[Lord Exo]] is not able to fully gain control of it, he transfers his soul to [[Kronus]]'s body, killing the '''Rift Walker''' in a spectacle of light. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|{{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} Null & Void Event Night 1 All Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Rift Walker''' in the second and ending cutscene of [[Outpost 16]].
